# Know Your Meme & TV Guide

> > Comprehensive database of internet memes, viral trends, and TV programming information spanning TikTok trends, exploitable image macros, and entertainment listings.

This site combines Know Your Meme's extensive documentation of viral internet culture (including TikTok trends, catchphrases, and image macros) with TV Guide's television scheduling and entertainment news. It serves as a reference for understanding contemporary meme culture alongside traditional media programming.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends and viral videos
- Exploitable memes and image macros
- Catchphrase memes
- TV listings and schedules
- Entertainment and celebrity news
- Social media platforms (TikTok, Twitter/X, Facebook, DeviantArt)
- Dance memes and trends
- Nostalgia-driven content
- Live sports programming
- Viral personalities and creators
- Breaking Bad references
- Hood movie culture
- Mental health humor

## TV Listings & Entertainment

- [TV Guide - Homepage](https://tvguide.com): Homepage with streaming recommendations, reviews, and entertainment news
- [TV Listings](https://tvguide.com/Listings): TV schedule listings and channel information for shows/movies/programs
- [Live Sports On TV Today](https://tvguide.com/sports/live-today): Today's live sports schedule: MLB, NBA, NHL, NCAA, UEFA Champions League

## Popular Meme References

- [Jesse, What the Fuck Are You Talking About](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/jesse-what-the-fuck-are-you-talking-about): Breaking Bad dialogue meme with Walter White and Jesse Pinkman
- [We Still Talk About You](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme from DeviantArt art depicting girl over cat/kitten
- [I'm Talking About Innit](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend from BunnaB/YKNiece rap song with swimming gesture
- [How About A Nice Big Cup of Shut the Fuck Up](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/how-about-a-nice-big-cup-of-shut-the-fuck-up): WWII poster-based catchphrase meme trending on TikTok

## Viral Trend Guides & Explainers

- [Saxophones In The Hood Meme Explained](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/what-do-the-memes-about-hearing-saxophones-in-the-hood-mean-the-viral-90s-hood-movie-trend-explained): Guide explaining Boyz n the Hood saxophone meme trend on TikTok/Instagram
- [Bananas And Rice Girl / Nasra Ahmed Explained](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/who-is-the-bananas-and-rice-girl-the-viral-memes-about-somali-american-ice-victim-nasra-ahmed-explained): Guide explaining viral Nasra Ahmed ICE detention speech memes

## Meme Collections

- [22 Memes About Mental Health That Are A Little Too Relatable](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/collections/22-memes-about-mental-health-that-are-a-little-too-relatable): Collection of relatable mental health and depression humor memes
